name: Bug report
about: Something builds wrongly, fails, or behaves differently from the docs

## What happened

A short description of the problem, and what you expected instead.

## Reproduction

The command you ran and the smallest config that shows the problem.

```bash
hybld build ...
```

## Environment

- hybld version (`hybld --version`):
- Backend: React + Vite / Next.js (App or Pages Router) / Astro
- Framework version:
- CMS adapter:
- Node version:
- OS:

## Output

The build summary and any error text. `.hybld/last-build.json` is helpful when pages were built, skipped or deleted unexpectedly. Remove credentials and private URLs before pasting.
